business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Internet - Marketplace FBA Store

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el Texto Refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC): Articles 5 and 20-31 (constitution and minimum capital), Article 21 (public deed), Articles 22-23 (required deed content and bylaws), Articles 33-39 (registered office), Articles 209-214 (administrator appointment), and Articles 32 and 62 (constitutive registration); supplemented by Article 4 bis (sociedad limitada de formación sucesiva) as introduced by Ley 18/2022 (Ley Crea y Crece).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (name reservation) and Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province of the registered office, administered under the Ministry of Justice by the Colegio de Registradores de la Propiedad y Mercantiles de España.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura de Constitución (public deed of incorporation) executed before a Spanish Notario, incorporating the Estatutos Sociales (Articles of Association), filed for inscription with the provincial Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Standard SL: registered capital of at least EUR 3,000, fully subscribed and paid up at incorporation. The capital must be deposited in escrow in a Spanish bank account opened in the name of the company in formation; the bank issues a certificate of deposit (certificado de depósito) which is attached to the public deed, and funds are released only after the deed is registered (or returned if the company is not registered within two months). Alternative: a Sociedad Limitada de Formación Sucesiva may be created with a minimum capital of EUR 1 under Article 4 bis LSC, subject to statutory restrictions on dividend distribution and administrator remuneration until the capital reaches EUR 3,000.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the incorporation formalities having been concluded, this Board hereby (1) accepts the subscription and full payment of the share capital as reflected in the public deed of incorporation; (2) adopts as the registered office of the company the address stated in Article 5 of the Bylaws; (3) confirms the appointment of the persons named as sole administrator; and (4) authorizes the administrator to execute the tax census filing (model 036), open bank accounts, and complete the registration of the deed with the Commercial Registry. The Board further ratifies all acts performed by the founding partners and grants the administrator the broadest powers to carry out all necessary filings until the company is definitively registered.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation with the Central Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central, Ministry of Justice, Madrid — official online platform of the Colegio de Registradores de España
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the application for a negative name certificate (certificación negativa de denominación) indicating the legal form 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' and up to five alternative names in order of preference, either electronically through the registry portal or in person. The Central Registry queries the corporate name index and issues the certificate once the chosen denomination is free; the certificate reserves the name for three non-renewable months.
required_dossiers: Signed application form for negative name certificate
Identity document of the applicant promoter (DNI, NIE, or passport)
Consent of the proposed sole administrator to accept the appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is refused because the requested name belongs to another entity, the promoter immediately files a fresh application with the remaining alternative names; if a collision is declared after issuance, request a new negative certificate under a different denomination before notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the Escrow Bank Account and Deposit of Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution supervised by the Banco de España
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The promoter opens a temporary account in the name of 'Company Name, S.L. (en constitución)' and deposits the fully subscribed capital (minimum EUR 3,000). The bank issues a certificate of deposit certifying the holder, the amount, and the account number, which must be presented to the notary at deed execution. Funds are contractually blocked and can be used only upon registration of the company or returned if incorporation fails.
required_dossiers: Passport or NIE of each founding partner
Name reservation certificate issued by the Central Registry
AML/KYC forms and declaration of source of funds
Proposed object and address details for the bank file
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests further anti-money-laundering documentation, provide notarized proof of funds and tax-residence certificates; if the bank refuses the file, open the account at another Banco de España-supervised institution to maintain the strict incorporation timetable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation and Bylaws before a Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario of the place of the registered office, Consejo General del Notariado
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: All founding partners appear before the notary, who verifies their legal capacity and the identity of the signatories. The notary executes the escritura de constitución incorporating the estatutos sociales, which include the firm name, corporate object, registered office, share capital structure, administration regime, and the exact distribution of quotas. The bank certificate of deposit is attached or the payments are verified in the deed, and the notary issues the first (primera copia) and simple (copia simple) copies.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate from the Central Registry
Bank certificate of capital deposit (certificado de depósito)
Identity documents and NIE of all founding partners
Draft Estatutos Sociales approved by the partners
Statement of the appointed administrator accepting office
Proof of payment of the notary fee (arancel notarial)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary issues an objection (advertencia) to a statutory clause, the partners approve an amendment and the deed is re-executed; if any partner lacks valid identification, the NIE process is completed first and the notarial appointment is rescheduled without losing the registry timeline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for the Provisional Tax Identification Number (NIF) with the Tax Agency
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) — electronic headquarters and territorial tax offices
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 calendar days following execution of the deed, submit the census declaration (modelo 036) to the AEAT to obtain the provisional NIF (formerly CIF) for the company in formation. The declaration also includes the assignment of territoriality and the information required to open the company's expected tax obligations. The AEAT issues the provisional NIF immediately upon correct validation; this NIF will be replaced by the definitive NIF after registry registration.
required_dossiers: Primera copia of the public deed of incorporation
Applicant's DNI or NIE with tax residence confirmation
Modelo 036 census declaration duly completed
Power of attorney if filed through a representative
For non-resident shareholders: modelo 030 and tax residence certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEAT rejects or queries the filing due to data inconsistencies, correct the census statement in line with the deed and resubmit electronically; an in-person curbside correction at the AEAT office with the deed and NIE normally resolves the query within hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Incorporation Deed with the Provincial Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province of the registered office, Colegio de Registradores de España
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within two months of the date of the deed, submit the primera copia of the escritura to the provincial Registro Mercantil and pay the official registration tariff calculated by the registrar. The registrar examines the legality of the deed and, if no defect exists, issues the inscription (inscripción), which confers legal personality on the company (inscripción constitutiva). A certified copy of the registration entry is then issued for post-registration formalities.
required_dossiers: Primera copia of the public deed of incorporation
Provisional NIF (modelo 036 acknowledgement) if already obtained
Evidence of payment of the registry fee (liquidación del registro)
Exemption declaration or model 600 form for capital transactions (AJD exemption)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar returns a nota de calificación with defects, the partners execute a rectification deed or an amendment deed before the same notary to cure the defect, and the corrected document is resubmitted within the legal period; disputed califications may be appealed before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Formalization: Definitive NIF, Employer Registration and Electronic Signature
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: AEAT; Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS) via the RED system; FNMT-RCM electronic certification service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the inscription is certified, the company applies to the AEAT for the definitive NIF by amending the census declaration (modelo 036), registers as an employer with the TGSS to obtain the employer account code (código de cuenta de cotización), obtains the digital certificate for legal persons through the FNMT-RCM, and registers the administrator's appointment in further registry filings where applicable. The bank then releases the escrowed capital and the company can lease premises, open market accounts, and hire employees.
required_dossiers: Certification of registration issued by the Registro Mercantil
Provisional NIF and modelo 036 acknowledgement
Amended modelo 036/039 census confirmation
TGSS RED system registration file with administrador data
DNI/NIE of the administrator for the FNMT certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the definitive NIF is not issued automatically from the registry linkage, file a corrective census declaration or a recurso de reposición and attach the registry certification; for TGSS registration delays, request the provisional employer number and coordinate with the provincial TGSS office.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal authority (Ayuntamiento) competent for the registered office — concejalía responsible for urban activity, opening licenses and economic promotion; regional Consejería de Medio Ambiente for environmental elements; no state-level industrial license is required for ISIC 4791 online retail without physical sales premises.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Apertura / Declaración Responsable de Actividad Económica (municipal activity and opening clearance) under the applicable Autonomous Community regulation; for Amazon FBA operations the usual title is the municipal Declaración Responsable de Apertura or, for larger warehouses, the Licencia de Actividad Clasificada.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Consejería competente en materia de medio ambiente of the Autonomous Community (coordinated with the Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico, MITERD)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full EIA for standard FBA warehouse activities below the threshold of 1,000 m2 of built area and with no hazardous waste generation; only municipal environmental registration (actividad inocua or evaluación ambiental simplificada) is required under Ley 21/2013 and regional environmental lists; projects exceeding the thresholds require a simplified EIAr/EIA report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater to municipal sewerage: Royal Decree 1290/2012 thresholds (pH 6-9; chemical oxygen demand below 1,000 mg/L; total suspended solids below 300 mg/L; oils and greases below 250 mg/L); volatile organic compound storage: Royal Decree 117/2003 limit of 100 mg C/m3 for solvent-loaded gases; waste segregation and packaging registration through Ley 7/2022 and Ley 11/1997 with authorized waste-manager contracts for cardboard, film and mixed commercial waste.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety compliance under Código Técnico de la Edificación (CTE DB-SI) and RIPCI (Royal Decree 513/2017): fire extinguishers, emergency exits, emergency lighting, smoke detection and evacuation planning; structural load clearance per CTE DB-SE-AE for mezzanine shelving; occupational risk assessment (evaluación de riesgos laborales) pursuant to Ley 31/1995 and Royal Decree 39/1997, and work center opening communication (comunicación de apertura del centro de trabajo) filed with the regional labor authority; all clearances must be renewed on change of premises or substantial refurbishment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); official internet portal: Sede Electrónica de la Agencia Tributaria, https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es; regional Haciendas Forales (Bizkaia, Gipuzkoa, Álava, Navarra) exercise territorial inspection and collection powers, but VAT and Impuesto sobre Sociedades are state tax competences managed by AEAT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a non-resident-owned SL: (1) Obtain NIE (Número de Identidad de Extranjero) for all non-resident shareholders and administrators from the Spanish Consulate or Oficina de Extranjería; execute the public deed before a Spanish notary after depositing capital in a Spanish bank; (2) Register the deed in the Registro Mercantil and simultaneously apply to AEAT for a provisional NIF (código de identificación fiscal) using Model 036, attaching the deed copy and notarial certification; the provisional NIF is valid for 6 months; (3) Obtain the definitive NIF certificate from the AEAT Delegación after inscription; (4) Enrol the SL in the Censo de Empresarios, Profesionales y Retenedores via Model 036/037, declaring ISIC 4791 activity, VAT settlement period (quarterly or monthly), and IAE status; (5) Obtain an EORI number (ES plus NIF) from AEAT Customs for direct exports to non-EU markets; (6) File the foreign investment statistical declaration (Modelo DP-2) with the Registro de Inversiones Exteriores when non-resident participation is acquired or increased; (7) Upload the definitive NIF, VAT certificate, and bank details (SEPA, Airwallex, Stripe, Amazon Pay) into Amazon Seller Central. A foreign entity selling without a Spanish SL would instead require a non-resident NIF (type N) and, where applicable, a fiscal representative; the ES_SL is tax resident in Spain by incorporation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. The SL (Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada) is a resident corporate taxpayer under Art. 8.1 Ley 27/2014 (LIS); ordinary SLs cannot elect pass-through treatment. Corporate income tax applies at 25% general rate (Art. 29.1 LIS), or 15% for newly incorporated economic enterprises during the first two tax periods with positive taxable base. The SL is taxed on worldwide income without territorial limitation; dividends distributed to non-resident shareholders trigger non-resident income tax (IRNR) at 19% unless reduced by a tax treaty or the Parent-Subsidiary Directive. Shareholders are not taxed on undistributed profits.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain has no check-the-box election; SL classification is fixed by company law. Available statutory elections: (a) consolidated tax group under Arts. 61-69 LIS (75% direct or indirect control at year-start) allowing group-wide offsetting of profits and losses; (b) VAT grouping under Art. 161 quaterdecies LIVA for permanently established Spanish entities, with single VAT number and monthly filing, minimum duration 3 calendar years; (c) simplified VAT regime (régimen simplificado) for eligible SMEs (turnover up to EUR 250,000 for goods or EUR 125,000 for services) but generally not applicable to Amazon FBA retail; (d) OSS (One Stop Shop) election for intra-EU B2C distance sales once the EUR 10,000 EU-wide threshold is exceeded; (e) cash-basis VAT regime (criterio de caja) for SMEs with turnover up to EUR 2,000,000, deferring output VAT until customer payment; (f) anti-hybrid disclosure and adjustment obligations under Law 11/2021 (ATAD transposition) requiring reporting through Model 200 and DAC6 (Model D6) for cross-border hybrid mismatches.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido) - Spanish Value Added Tax, harmonised with EU Directive 2006/112/EC, codified in Ley 37/1992 (LIVA).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover exemption threshold for taxable supplies with a place of supply in Spain: registration (alta censal, Model 036) is mandatory from the first euro of taxable activity. Relevant trigger points: EUR 10,000 annual EU-wide B2C intra-EU distance-sales threshold, above which the SL must charge Spanish VAT or destination VAT via OSS or local registration; no threshold for inbound FBA warehouse stock in Spain, so a foreign seller must register (NIF-N or representative) from the first import; imports of third-country goods require payment of import VAT at customs, with IOSS available for consignments up to EUR 150; B2B supplies to VAT-registered Spanish customers fall under reverse charge (Art. 84.Uno LIVA) and do not require local registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Two regimes apply. SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información): mandatory for taxpayers with annual taxed volume above EUR 6,000,000 and for VAT groups; real-time XML filing of invoice books via AEAT web services within 4 working days of issue or receipt. VeriFactu: Royal Decree 1007/2023 and Ley Crea y Crece impose structured electronic invoicing (XBRL/XML) with QR code, hash-chain digital stamping, and software certification for all entrepreneurs; phased deadlines from 1 July 2025 for entities with turnover over EUR 8,000,000 and from 1 January 2026 for all others; AEAT maintains an electronic registry for compatible software. Regional TicketBAI obligations (QR invoicing) apply in Basque Country and Navarra. Amazon FBA sellers must issue compliant commercial invoices for B2B and B2C transactions; AEAT cross-verifies marketplace settlement data against filed VAT returns, and non-compliant software triggers sanctions of EUR 150 per invoice up to a cumulative cap plus verification penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods physically leaving EU customs territory qualify for 0% VAT with full input VAT deduction under Art. 21 LIVA, provided: (i) the SL is the exporter (EORI holder named in the customs declaration); (ii) goods exit the EU within customs timeframes (normally proven at levante within 90 days, extendable to 12 months with justified cause); (iii) the transaction is a genuine remunerated sale to a non-EU customer; (iv) invoice is issued to the non-EU party; and (v) no fraud or simulation exists. Offshore and cross-border services supplied B2B to non-EU recipients are outside Spanish VAT under Art. 69 LIVA and may be deductible under Art. 70 LIVA subject to customer-status evidence. Intra-EU B2C distance sales via Amazon FBA are not zero-rated; they are taxed at destination through OSS or local registration, while intra-EU B2B supplies to registered customers are exempt with reverse charge under Art. 25 LIVA. FBA exports to third countries (UK, USA, Latin America) use the export zero-rating path and require Amazon logistics evidence, outbound carrier proofs, and customs declarations.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DUA - Documento Único Administrativo (Single Administrative Document) with export declaration, levante confirmation, and exit record referencing the EORI of ES_SL
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, CMR, or certified courier manifest evidencing physical departure from EU customs territory with route and timestamps matching the DUA
Commercial invoice issued by ES_SL to the non-EU buyer in Spanish or English, including HS codes, Incoterms 2020, and EUR pricing
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank SWIFT MT103 or settlement ledger (Amazon Pay, Airwallex, Stripe) evidencing receipt of payment from the foreign buyer
Packing list and, where claimed, certificate of origin or export licence for controlled goods
Amazon FBA logistics report: shipment event logs, courier receipts, and outbound warehouse handover documents proving routing outside the EU
EORI registration certificate issued by AEAT Customs
Intrastat and Supplementary Declarations, where applicable, segregating intra-EU dispatch from third-country exports
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT disallows zero-rating where documentary proof fails the 90-day departure test or where the export is judged simulated. Penalties under Ley General Tributaria (LGT 58/2003): Art. 191 imposes a 50-150% penalty on undue VAT refunds or wrongly claimed exemptions, with late-payment interest (Art. 26) set at the statutory rate plus at least 25%; voluntary non-filed declarations attract recargos of 5-20%. Criminal liability arises under Código Penal Art. 305 where fraud exceeds EUR 120,000, punishable by 1-5 years imprisonment plus fines up to six times the defrauded amount; organised carousel fraud receives aggravated treatment. AEAT special control plans use Amazon Seller Central data to compare settlement reports against IVA returns, enabling retrospective clawback up to the full limitation period (4-10 years) without interruption; exporters must retain DUA, exit proofs, and payment records for at least 10 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain) acting as the national central bank within the Eurosystem, together with the Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones (DGCOMEX) of the Ministry of Industry, Trade and Tourism as the Spanish foreign trade and investment authority; the legal framework is governed by EU capital movement rules, Royal Decree 1816/1991 on foreign exchange, Law 19/2003 on capital movements, and Law 18/2022 on foreign investment screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain applies full convertibility for the euro in both current and capital accounts. There are no exchange controls, no prior authorisation for ordinary profit remittance or dividend distribution to non-resident shareholders, and no surrender requirements. Remittance is subject solely to standard corporate documentary formalities (board resolution approving dividends, audited annual accounts, tax clearance certificates) and to statistical reporting obligations, mainly the Banco de España balance-of-payments survey for transactions with non-residents exceeding the applicable monthly threshold (generally EUR 1.5 million), as well as post-investment registration with the DGCOMEX.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender, forced conversion, or mandatory repatriation timeline applies to export proceeds in Spain. Export receipts may be retained in any currency and held in non-resident or foreign-currency accounts freely. For statistical purposes, all export transactions must be reported to the Banco de España through the authorised reporting channels when the aggregate monthly value of international settlements exceeds the legal threshold (generally EUR 1.5 million). The reporting obligation does not require conversion to EUR and does not restrict the use of funds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de Capital) and Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente)
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) with e-commerce sub-ledger
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) / Amazon FBA settlement account
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) with multi-currency module

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High for EU-authorised electronic money institutions (EMIs) that have passported into Spain under PSD2 and Law 21/2011 (e.g., Stripe Technology Europe, Airwallex Europe, Revolut). Medium for UK-authorised EMIs that lost EU passporting rights after Brexit and must operate through a Spanish branch or an EU-authorised partner. Low for offshore non-EU digital payment providers, which are prohibited from issuing e-money or holding payment accounts for Spanish legal entities without a licence from or passport notification to the Banco de España; such providers may only be used as supplementary payment initiation or card-acquiring services, not as the primary treasury account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance by the legal representative (administrador único or solidario) and, where beneficial ownership is exercised through a corporate entity, the ultimate beneficial owner(s) is mandatory at the initial branch interview for tier-1 Spanish banks. Remote account opening is available only in exceptional cases using a recognised qualified electronic signature (DNIe/certificado digital), with video identification, and always subject to the bank's internal policy approval; most Spanish banks require a physical board resolution, original/notarised public deed, and the corporate tax identification number (NIF) before activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency, small-ticket settlement credits from Amazon without corresponding supporting documents
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amazon Seller Central statements, FBA shipment reports, commercial invoices to Amazon Payments Europe S.C.A., warehouse and logistics proofs (customs declarations, bill of lading, courier receipts), and monthly VAT returns (Modelo 303) reconciled to account inflows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Name-only beneficial ownership with no economic substance or physical trading address
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current register of beneficial owners (Registro de Titularidades Reales), notarised deed of incorporation, shareholders' register, management organ appointment, tax registration certificates (IAE, CIF), and proof of operating substance such as a lease, warehouse agreement, or third-party logistics contract.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments to suppliers in high-risk or remote jurisdictions (e.g., China, Hong Kong, Singapore, UAE) without verifiable trade chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Purchase order or framework agreement with the supplier, supplier KYC file (business licence, passport of signatory), transport documents with GPS tracking, EU customs entry documents (DUA/IOSS), commercial invoices, and bank transfer records matching the value chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border dividend or capital remittance to non-resident shareholders creating fund-flow mismatch
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate resolution approving the distribution, audited financial statements, tax settlement certificates, NIF/QIE proof of the non-resident shareholder, source-of-wealth details, and prior DGCOMEX foreign investment registration when applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Refund, chargeback, and returns cycles unusually high relative to retail sales, indicating potential money laundering layering
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Returns policy documentation, Amazon chargeback evidence, reconciliation between sales reports and refunds, accounting ledger entries, PSP service agreements, and an internal risk-control policy demonstrating customer due diligence.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant capital injections must be made by wire transfer or SEPA credit transfer in EUR to the SL's capital escrow or operational account at a Spanish bank, using SWIFT MT103 with the ISO 20022 purpose code CAPC and remittance text 'Aportación de capital social'. The transfer must originate from the shareholder's verifiable bank account; cash or crypto conversions are not accepted. After receipt, the company must (i) file the foreign investment declaration (Form D-2) with the DGCOMEX within one month of the investment for non-EU investors (or where applicable for EU investors above the relevant threshold), (ii) report to the Banco de España under the balance-of-payments statistics regime if the transaction exceeds the applicable amount, and (iii) maintain a notarial public deed or private agreement with stamp duty proof for higher amounts.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For international supplier and operating payments, the SL will use: (i) SEPA Credit Transfer and SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for EU-based suppliers and Amazon-related fees; (ii) SWIFT MT103 with specific ISO 15022/20022 purpose codes and remittance documentation for non-EU suppliers; (iii) Commercial Letters of Credit, documentary collections, or supply chain finance instruments for high-value procurement, particularly where Chinese or other Asia-Pacific suppliers demand additional payment security; and (iv) Amazon's own payouts flow into the Spanish bank account in EUR via SEPA from Amazon Payments Europe S.C.A., enabling automated treasury sweeping into payables and operating accounts.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forward contracts (compraventa de divisas a plazo)
Currency call and put options on USD, GBP, and emerging-market currencies
Non-deliverable forwards (NDF) for restricted or exotic currencies

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual accounts must be approved by the shareholders' meeting within six months of the fiscal year-end and filed within one month thereafter; for a calendar year-end, filing deadline is no later than 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties of EUR 1,500 to EUR 30,000 per year of delay; inability to obtain a positive registry certificate; continued non-filing leads to administrative closure and potential strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Tax Administration Agency (AEAT - Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 calendar days following the six-month period after the tax year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers, no later than 25 July of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 5%, 10%, 15%, or 20% of the tax due plus late-interest charges; additional penalty scale of up to 150% of the amount; refusal of tax compliance certificates and interruption of public procurement windows.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Tax Administration Agency (AEAT - Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the last day of February of the following year (28 February in non-leap years) where aggregate annual transactions with a third party exceed EUR 3,005.06.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of EUR 150 to EUR 300 per omitted or inaccurate data item with a minimum assessment of EUR 300; inaccurate returns may be reclassified as an administrative tax offense.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Commercial Registry Confirmation (Registro de Titularidades Reales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Central Commercial Registry / Ministry of Justice (Registro Mercantil Central / Ministerio de Justicia)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: UBO information must be filed at incorporation and within one month of any change in ownership or control; no separate annual form is required when ownership remains unchanged, but the annual accounts filing must remain consistent with the registered UBO data.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance is a serious infringement under Law 10/2010; fines from EUR 3,000 to EUR 60,000 per violation; failure may block registry filings and corporate transactions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies when, for two consecutive years, a company meets at least two of the following: total assets exceed EUR 2,850,000; annual net turnover exceeds EUR 5,700,000; average number of employees exceeds 50. Companies exceeding these thresholds, or required by shareholders' agreement or commercial registry rules, must appoint an auditor.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP (Plan General Contable) for individual company accounts; IFRS as endorsed by the EU is mandatory for consolidated accounts of listed groups and may be voluntarily adopted by other groups. Small and medium-sized scopes may apply simplified PGC requirements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Spanish law requires every company to maintain an internal beneficial ownership register and to file any UBO changes with the Commercial Registry within one month of the triggering event. There is no annual UBO confirmation return where ownership remains static, but the directors must confirm at each annual accounts approval that the registered beneficial ownership data reflects current reality, and any share transfer that changes UBO must be recorded before the annual accounts submission.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro Registro de Órganos de Administración)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Newly incorporated entities may apply a 15% rate in the first profitable tax period and the immediately following period, subject to statutory exclusions, including patrimonial entities and entities forming part of certain pre-existing business reorganizations. Qualifying start-up companies may also apply the 15% rate during the applicable statutory period. Spanish tax law provides indefinite tax-loss carryforward, subject to annual utilization limits generally ranging from 25% to 70% of the pre-utilization tax base depending on prior-year net turnover; a EUR 1 million minimum annual offset is generally available. The requested five-year schema value is not legally applicable to Spain.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 200, Corporate Income Tax return, filed electronically through the Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT) electronic headquarters using a qualified electronic certificate or other accepted electronic identification.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within the 25 calendar days following the six-month period after the end of the tax year. For a calendar-year company ending on 31 December, the normal filing window is 1 to 25 July; where the final day is not a business day, the deadline moves to the next business day.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, Spanish tax identification number (NIF), registered office, tax period dates, legal form, activity classification and filing status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Spanish SL's NIF and Spanish registered office. The foreign shareholder's identification is reported separately and does not replace the SL's taxpayer identity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Balance sheet and profit and loss accounts
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting assets, liabilities, equity, turnover, cost of goods sold, logistics costs, marketplace commissions, payment-processing costs, personnel costs, depreciation, provisions and finance costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all transactions attributable to the Spanish SL, including Amazon settlement receipts and inventory held in Spain or other EU fulfillment centers where recorded by the company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Permanent and temporary differences between Spanish statutory accounting profit and taxable income, including non-deductible expenses, depreciation differences, provisions, impairment, related-party adjustments and tax-exempt income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not deduct shareholder, group or foreign-entity expenses without business purpose, documentation and arm's-length support.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting result after statutory tax adjustments, application of permitted tax-loss carryforwards and other legally available reductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-source losses or losses of a foreign affiliate are not automatically deductible by the Spanish SL.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Application of the general 25% rate or a qualifying 15% rate, followed by calculation of gross corporate income tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A 15% rate requires confirmation of statutory eligibility for the relevant tax periods and exclusion of patrimonial or reorganized pre-existing business status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Tax credits, withholdings and payments on account
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable tax credits, advance payments, Spanish withholding tax suffered, instalment payments and other amounts payable or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Amazon, Stripe, Airwallex and other payment intermediaries generally do not replace the company's corporate tax obligations or advance-payment requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Transactions with shareholders, directors, group companies, common-control entities and other related parties, including financing, services, royalties, goods and reimbursements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report Spanish-company transactions with non-resident related parties and retain contemporaneous arm's-length support.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct and, where required, ultimate ownership information and participation percentages.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify non-resident shareholders using their foreign tax identification details and provide Spanish tax representation or documentation where required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount payable or refundable, direct-debit or payment reference, and bank-account information.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure the payment account and electronic authorization are compatible with AEAT procedures; a foreign shareholder's bank account does not eliminate Spanish payment obligations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing without tax payable may attract a fixed penalty generally starting at EUR 200, reduced by 50% for voluntary filing without prior notice where applicable. Late filing with tax payable generally attracts a surcharge of 1% plus 1% for each complete month of delay during the first 12 months; after 12 months, the surcharge is generally 15% plus applicable late-payment interest. Formal breaches, inaccurate returns and fraudulent conduct may trigger additional penalties of 50% to 150% of the improperly unpaid amount.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 202, Corporate Income Tax instalment payment, filed electronically through the AEAT electronic headquarters.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly instalment periods in April, October and December
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Generally 1 to 20 April, October and December, with the filing and payment window commonly extending to 15 April, October and December where direct debit is used. The payment is calculated under the applicable statutory method; companies with net turnover of at least EUR 6 million must generally use the tax-base method.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NIF, legal name, tax period and instalment period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Spanish SL's NIF and not the foreign shareholder's identification number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prior-year tax-liability method or current-period tax-base method, as legally applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Review the mandatory current-period method if the company or relevant tax group exceeds the statutory turnover threshold.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Reference tax liability or current-period tax base
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prior-year corporate tax liability excluding credits, or current-period adjusted tax base and applicable rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include Spanish taxable profits and properly documented adjustments; do not net unrelated foreign-company profits or losses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Percentage applied, instalment due, prior instalments and adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile the amount to the accounting ledger, Modelo 200 and marketplace settlement records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payment reference, direct debit mandate or other accepted electronic payment method.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain valid electronic authority and sufficient funds on the payment date.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment is subject to statutory surcharges generally ranging from 5% to 20%, depending on the delay and whether payment is voluntary before enforcement, plus applicable late-payment interest. Failure to file, inaccurate data or deliberate concealment may create separate formal and substantive penalties.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 19% on dividends and other profit distributions paid by a Spanish company to a non-resident, subject to domestic exemptions and treaty relief. The EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive exemption may eliminate withholding where the statutory conditions are met, commonly including qualifying EU or EEA residence, a minimum 5% participation, a minimum one-year holding period or undertaking to hold, qualifying legal-form and subject-to-tax requirements, and anti-abuse compliance.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Before payment, obtain a valid certificate of tax residence from the recipient's foreign tax authority, verify beneficial ownership, treaty entitlement, limitation-on-benefits or principal-purpose requirements where relevant, and retain ownership, holding-period and subject-to-tax evidence. Apply the reduced treaty rate at source only where Spanish procedural requirements are satisfied; otherwise withhold at the domestic rate and allow the recipient to seek a refund through the AEAT procedure. Maintain board resolutions, dividend calculations, payment records and Form 123/193 withholding reporting. Treaty outcomes vary by recipient jurisdiction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic Spanish non-resident income tax generally applies 19% to interest and 24% to royalties paid to non-residents outside the EU/EEA, subject to statutory exceptions and treaty reductions. The EU Interest and Royalties Directive may exempt qualifying associated EU companies where minimum ownership, holding-period, legal-form, subject-to-tax and anti-abuse conditions are met. Tax treaties commonly reduce royalty and interest withholding rates, frequently to 0% to 10%, but the applicable rate must be confirmed under the specific treaty. Payments to related parties require beneficial-owner, substance, transfer-pricing and treaty-entitlement evidence.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: The principal Spanish documentation exemption applies where the aggregate value of transactions with the same related person or entity does not exceed EUR 250,000 at arm's length during the relevant tax period, subject to exclusions and special rules. Local-file documentation is generally required for material related-party transactions outside the exemption. A master file is generally required for Spanish entities belonging to a group with prior-year consolidated net turnover of at least EUR 750 million, subject to Spanish and international reporting rules. Country-by-country reporting generally applies at the EUR 750 million consolidated group threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain does not operate a single standalone regime labelled Economic Substance Regulations equivalent to certain offshore jurisdictions. Substance is nevertheless required under Spanish anti-abuse, beneficial-ownership, controlled-foreign-company, interest-deduction, treaty, EU Parent-Subsidiary, EU Interest and Royalties and general anti-avoidance rules. A Spanish SL should maintain genuine local decision-making, appropriate personnel or outsourced operational capacity, premises or operational infrastructure, commercial risk control, Spanish accounting and banking records, inventory and logistics evidence, and a business rationale consistent with its Amazon FBA activities. Conduit arrangements, circular payments and entities lacking commercial function may lose treaty or directive benefits and may trigger reassessment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Corporate income tax evasion and aggravated tax fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing Amazon sales, foreign fulfillment-center inventory, payment-platform receipts, related-party charges or beneficial ownership, or deliberately understating taxable profit where the unpaid tax exceeds the criminal threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative tax penalties commonly range from 50% to 150% of the unpaid tax. Tax fraud involving more than EUR 120,000 in a tax period may constitute a criminal offense punishable generally by imprisonment of 1 to 5 years and a fine of 1 to 6 times the amount defrauded, together with loss of public subsidies and tax benefits. Aggravated cases, including amounts exceeding EUR 600,000 or organized conduct, may carry imprisonment of 2 to 6 years and a fine of 2 to 6 times the amount defrauded.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who order, authorize or knowingly facilitate the conduct may incur criminal liability, civil restitution, fines, disqualification from public office or profession and asset-seizure consequences. Directors may also face subsidiary tax liability where statutory management-liability conditions are met. Travel restrictions may be ordered by a court where necessary; imprisonment applies only under the relevant criminal judgment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False accounting and fraudulent corporate records
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining parallel ledgers, fabricating invoices, misclassifying personal expenses as inventory or marketing, suppressing payment-platform statements, or manipulating stock and revenue recognition.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Potential corporate, tax and accounting penalties, reassessment, interest and, where criminal elements exist, imprisonment and fines under Spanish criminal law for false accounting, document falsification or related offenses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and managers who knowingly approve false accounts may incur criminal, civil and disqualification liability. The corporate veil may be disregarded for fraud, abuse of legal personality or asset diversion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Value Added Tax and intra-EU distance-sales non-compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to register or report Spanish VAT, misapplying the One Stop Shop, omitting EU distance sales, treating marketplace-facilitated supplies incorrectly, or failing to reconcile stock transfers and fulfillment-center movements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VAT reassessment, late-payment interest, fixed and proportional penalties, and potential criminal tax fraud where the applicable criminal threshold and intent requirements are met.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may incur subsidiary liability for deliberately or negligently causing unpaid tax and may face criminal liability for intentional VAT fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer-pricing manipulation and undocumented related-party transactions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging non-arm's-length management fees, royalties, financing or inventory prices to foreign affiliates, creating artificial losses in Spain, or failing to prepare required Local File, Master File or supporting analysis.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Primary adjustment to arm's-length income, secondary adjustment where applicable, late-payment interest and documentation penalties. Spanish documentation penalties may include fixed amounts per omitted, inaccurate or incomplete item and, in certain cases, a percentage of the related adjustment, subject to statutory caps.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face tax-liability derivation, civil claims and, where documentation is intentionally falsified or the conduct is fraudulent, criminal exposure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Improper dividend, interest or royalty withholding
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying non-residents without withholding, applying treaty or EU exemptions without residence, beneficial-ownership, holding-period or substance evidence, or failing to file withholding returns.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recovery of the unpaid withholding tax, late-payment interest, withholding-agent penalties and possible penalties of up to 150% of the unpaid amount for serious or fraudulent conduct.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The company is primarily liable as withholding agent. Directors may incur subsidiary liability for culpable non-payment, fraudulent documentation, asset dissipation or intentional concealment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company, treaty abuse and artificial substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Spanish SL solely as a conduit, routing dividends or royalties through it without commercial function, maintaining nominee directors, circularly remitting funds, or claiming EU or treaty relief without beneficial ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of exemptions or treaty relief, recharacterization of payments, tax reassessment, interest and penalties under anti-abuse and anti-avoidance rules.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face civil restitution, tax-liability derivation, disqualification and criminal liability where the arrangement involves fraud, concealment, money laundering or document falsification.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting unexplained third-party funds, disguising beneficial ownership, structuring payments, using personal accounts, failing to maintain customer or supplier due diligence, or ignoring suspicious marketplace and payment activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Spanish AML legislation, serious and very serious breaches may attract substantial fines, including amounts up to EUR 1.5 million, up to 5% of the entity's net worth or up to twice the value of the transaction or benefit, depending on the classification and applicable statutory limit, together with public reprimand, authorization restrictions or removal of responsible officers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers may be personally fined, removed or disqualified. Money laundering may carry criminal imprisonment, fines and confiscation. Courts may impose asset-freezing or travel restrictions where procedurally justified.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Customs, import VAT and origin fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Undervaluing imports, misdeclaring product classification or origin, splitting consignments, using false commercial invoices, or failing to reconcile Amazon FBA stock imported into Spain or the EU.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Customs debt, import VAT, interest, seizure or forfeiture of goods, customs penalties and potential criminal liability for smuggling or document fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and customs representatives may incur joint or subsidiary liability where they knowingly participate in false declarations or concealment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Profit diversion and unlawful shareholder distributions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing profits without distributable reserves, extracting funds through undocumented shareholder loans, paying personal expenses from the SL, or stripping assets before tax debts are paid.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Repayment of unlawful distributions, creditor and tax claims, interest, corporate liability and possible insolvency consequences.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be required to restore assets, compensate creditors, bear insolvency-related liability and face disqualification. Fraudulent asset diversion may result in imprisonment and confiscation.
